paper.title: TextGrad: Automatic "Differentiation" via Text
paper.central_claim: TextGrad 把复合 AI 系统视为计算图，让 LLM 作为反向引擎沿图传递文字批评(“文字梯度”)，用 Textual Gradient Descent 更新提示、解答、分子、治疗参数等变量；无需调参即可在 QA、编程、推理、分子与放疗任务上改进。
paper.scope_note: B类：反射式提示优化器（提示优化部分在范围内）；实例优化为单次输出自我修正(范围外)；分子/放疗为概念验证。

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref null: subagent dispatched via claude-kimi model type; no run receipt exposed to the worker (not probed). Score arithmetic: coverage is a 0..1 fraction; lower/upper are 0..100.

evidence.quote: backpropagates textual feedback provided by LLMs to improve individual components of a compound AI system.
evidence.support_explanation: 中心机制：把 LLM 的文字批评沿计算图反传，改进各变量。

evidence.quote: developing principled and automated ways to optimize AI systems is one of the most crucial challenges for building compound systems with LLMs
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：复合系统缺少原则性自动优化。

evidence.quote: Once implemented, the gradient operator for LLM calls are fixed throughout the framework for all applications.
evidence.support_explanation: 梯度算子与 TGD 对所有应用固定：改进器本身不被修改。

evidence.quote: The gradients are propagated through arbitrary functions, such as LLM API calls, simulators, or external numerical solvers.
evidence.support_explanation: 文字梯度可穿过任意函数。

evidence.quote: the goal is to find a prompt that improves the performance of an LLM across multiple queries for a task.
evidence.support_explanation: 提示优化：学得的提示跨查询复用（唯一有留存语义的用法）。

evidence.quote: training examples in total, sampled randomly with replacement.
evidence.support_explanation: 批大小3、12 次迭代，共见 36 个训练样本（有放回）。

evidence.quote: After each iteration, we run a validation loop with the validation set of the datasets, and if the performance is better than the previous iteration we update the Prompt
evidence.support_explanation: 接受规则：验证集更优才更新提示。

evidence.quote: we use gpt-4o to provide the feedback and improve the prompt.
evidence.support_explanation: 强教师(gpt-4o)提供反馈，被优化的是弱模型(gpt-3.5-turbo)的系统提示。

evidence.quote: and improves over DSPy by 7% for Object Counting.
evidence.support_explanation: 相对 DSPy BFSR：Word Sorting、GSM8k 持平，Object Counting +7。

evidence.quote: randomly split into 50/100/100 train/validation/test samples
evidence.support_explanation: BBH 两任务的划分。

evidence.quote: which has 200 (training)/300 (validation)/1319 (test) samples.
evidence.support_explanation: GSM8k 划分（沿用 DSPy）。

evidence.quote: We instantiate DSPy’s BootstrappedFewShotRandomSearch (BFSR) optimizer with 10 candidate programs and 8 few-shot examples.
evidence.support_explanation: DSPy 基线配置；未说明其教师模型与预算。

evidence.quote: directly combining the demonstrations from DSPy with the instruction from TextGrad increases the accuracy to 82.1%
evidence.support_explanation: 两者互补，组合更高。

evidence.quote: Results are averaged over 5 seeds.
evidence.support_explanation: LeetCode Hard：5 个种子的均值±（0.36±0.018 vs Reflexion 0.31±0.012）。

evidence.quote: it is likely that the dataset we are using in this manuscript is not the same dataset that was used in the Reflexion paper.
evidence.support_explanation: LeetCodeHard 重新抽取，与 Reflexion 原数据不同，基线为作者重跑。

evidence.quote: The number of coding problems in LeetCodeHard is 39.
evidence.support_explanation: LeetCode 仅 39 题。

evidence.quote: iterations of test-time updates (i.e. update the solution three times) and perform majority voting across all solutions to get the final answer.
evidence.support_explanation: GPQA/MMLU：3 次测试时更新+多数表决，对照为单次 CoT；推理算力不匹配。

evidence.quote: # Note how the loss is self-supervised (does not depend on any ground truth.)
evidence.support_explanation: 实例优化的测试时损失是自监督(LLM 自评)，无真值。

evidence.quote: additional language model calls to compute gradients (1 call using the gradient operator for each edge in the computation graph)
evidence.support_explanation: 每次迭代的额外调用数随图边数线性增长；是唯一的成本说明。

evidence.quote: the ultimate test requires experimental and clinical assessments, which are outside of the scope of this paper.
evidence.support_explanation: 分子/放疗仅为计算机内(in silico)概念验证。

evidence.quote: generates molecules with highly competitive affinity and druglikeness when compared to clinical molecules evaluated using the same loss function
evidence.support_explanation: 分子优化结果（仅 Vina/QED 两个代理指标）。

evidence.quote: optimized plans with the clinical plans used to treat five prostate cancer patients.
evidence.support_explanation: 放疗对比仅 5 位患者。

evidence.quote: we expand this analogy more broadly to automatic differentiation, and going substantially beyond prompt optimization tasks.
evidence.support_explanation: 与 ProTeGi 的差别：把文字梯度推广为自动微分并超越提示优化。

evidence.quote: both DSPy and ProTeGi focused on prompt optimization
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 DSPy 与 ProTeGi 仅限提示优化；与 ProTeGi/OPRO 无实证比较。

evidence.quote: the prompt-optimized weaker model can be used with cheaper inference costs instead of using the strong and more expensive model.
evidence.support_explanation: 成本论证：一次性优化成本换低推理成本，但优化成本未给数字。

evidence.quote: to compare the ground truth list to the response provided in the answer
evidence.support_explanation: Word Sorting 用 gpt-4o 评审，其余 GSM8k/Object Counting 为字符串精确匹配。

evidence.quote: make complementary adjustments—the former adds in-context demonstration examples and latter optimizes the system prompt.
evidence.support_explanation: TextGrad 优化指令、DSPy 优化示例，二者对象不同，不是同对象的替代优化器。

evidence.quote: framework using methods such as TextGrad itself is also an intriguing direction of future work.
evidence.support_explanation: 自应用(优化 TextGrad 自身)留作未来工作：不是 improver 闭环。

evidence.quote: The feedback may be noisy, identify what is important and what is correct.
evidence.support_explanation: 优化器提示承认反馈含噪，但无噪声鲁棒性实验。

evidence.quote: Here we use differentiation and gradients as a metaphor for textual feedback from LLMs.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者明确“梯度”只是隐喻。

evidence.quote: although their reliability can reduce with too many constraints
evidence.support_explanation: 约束遵守的可靠性随数量下降（作者自述）。

gap.author_gap: 复合 AI 系统多靠专家手工拼装；需要原则性自动优化，而神经网络靠反向传播变得 turn-key。
gap.checked_gap: 真实；非权重对象（提示/示例/实例）清楚。最近邻 ProTeGi（文字梯度）、DSPy（示例）、OPRO/Reflexion/Self-Refine 已覆盖单提示或单次输出改进，本文的增量主要是（1）统一的计算图/多变量抽象和（2）实例优化与多领域；但实验几乎都是深度≤2 的图、单变量，未证明跨组件反传的价值。
gap.lineage: 祖先：ProTeGi(文字梯度)、OPRO、Reflexion/Self-Refine(自我批评)、PyTorch autograd；最近邻：DSPy(示例自举)、ProTeGi。均为论文自述，本地无固定副本。
